pairs: Tu autem loquere quæ decent sanam doctrinam:
But you are to speak the things that befit sound doctrine.
Old women, similarly, should be in holy attire,
so that they may teach prudence to the young women,
so that they may love their husbands,
so that the Word of God may be not blasphemed.
Juvenes similiter hortare ut sobrii sint.
Exhort young men similarly, so that they may show self-restraint.
In omnibus teipsum præbe exemplum bonorum operum,
In all things, present yourself as an example of good works:
ut is qui ex adverso est, vereatur, nihil habens malum dicere de nobis.
so that he who is an opponent may dread that he has nothing evil to say about us.
Exhort servants to be submissive to their masters,
sed in omnibus fidem bonam ostendentes:
but in all things showing good fidelity,
ut doctrinam Salvatoris nostri Dei ornent in omnibus.
so that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.
Apparuit enim gratia Dei Salvatoris nostri omnibus hominibus,
For the grace of God our Savior has appeared to all men,
erudiens nos, ut abnegantes impietatem, et sæcularia desideria, sobrie, et juste, et pie vivamus in hoc sæculo,
instructing us to reject impiety and worldly desires, so that we may live soberly and justly and piously in this age,
looking forward to the blessed hope
and the advent of the glory of the great God
and of our Savior Jesus Christ.
He gave himself for our sake,
ut nos redimeret ab omni iniquitate,
so that he might redeem us from all iniquity,
and might cleanse for himself an acceptable people,
and argue these things with all authority.
